name: generate_texture
description: Re-textures an existing mesh using AI, given a text prompt describing the desired look. Requires a source MeshPart or Model. Replaces the source in place.

hintImage.description: Optional reference image guiding the texture style. When provided, textPrompt may be an empty string.

selectedInstanceRef.description: The source mesh: an InstanceRef pointing to a MeshPart or to a Model containing the mesh to re-texture.

uniqueId.description: Unique instance id of the source MeshPart or Model.

studio_id.description: Selects Roblox Studio instance, use the list_roblox_studios tool to get available instances

textPrompt.description: Text description of the desired texture/appearance, e.g. "rusty metal".
